verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a built-in AI assistant inside Isaac Sim, Lab, or ROS that users can delegate tasks to. Isaac Lab ships 'agent skills' for installation, environment creation, RL training and migration, and Isaac ROS offers an 'AI agent skill' for upgrading ROS 2 nodes. These skills are packaged for external AI coding agents, which makes them building blocks or adjacent features rather than an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit. 'Agent-ready' refers to the robot-learning framework and is unrelated to this story.
